Class NaturalEarthVectorIngestor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.NaturalEarthVectorIngestor
public class NaturalEarthVectorIngestor extends Object
High-Precision Ingestor for Natural Earth 1:10m Vector Datasets (Countries, Coastlines, Rivers, Lakes). Rasterizes high-definition vector features into 1024x512 multi-channel spatial tensors.
